fields.label: Story Content / Testimonial

fields.instructions: Name of the person sharing the story (e.g. Rita Khagram)

fields.label: Author Photo
fields.name: photo
fields.instructions: Upload author photo or headshot (optional, falls back to default avatar)

fields.label: Position / Role
fields.name: position
fields.instructions: Role or professional title (e.g. Business owner and investor)

fields.label: Location
fields.name: location
fields.instructions: Location or countries (e.g. England, Kenya & India)

fields.name: before_level
fields.instructions: Number of active segments before training (1=Red, 2=Amber, 3=Green, 4=Gold)

fields.label: After Zone Level
fields.name: after_level
fields.instructions: Number of active segments after training (1=Red, 2=Amber, 3=Green, 4=Gold)
